synthesia.name: Synthesia
critical_weaknesses: Uncanny valley effects, limited emotional expressiveness
synthesia.talk_track: Synthesia works for internal training videos where perfection doesn't matter. But when you're spending $5,000+ on a commercial that represents your brand, 'good enough' isn't enough.

heygen.name: HeyGen
heygen.talk_track: HeyGen is great until you hit a problem. Then you're stuck with AI-powered support that can't solve real business issues.

runway.name: Runway
runway.talk_track: Runway is powerful but requires a creative director who knows how to use professional editing software.

sora.name: Sora (OpenAI)
sora.talk_track: Sora is exciting but it's a creative toy right now, not a reliable commercial production tool.

wistia.name: Wistia
wistia.talk_track: Wistia is great for hosting and analytics, but you still need to create the video first. We handle the entire production pipeline.

competitive_advantages: Human creative director on every project
Real footage and actors, not uncanny valley avatars
Full Command Deck automation system included
